assert: Boolean(document.querySelector('input[name=fullName]')) && document.body.innerText.includes('Visit today')
description: Registration is one screen with an optional visit

name: fd-01-same-person
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('Is this the same person?') && document.body.innerText.includes('QA-PHC-000001-K2')
description: A likely existing record is offered while typing

name: fd-02-fee-preview
assert: !document.body.innerText.includes('Is this the same person?') && document.body.innerText.includes('To pay now') && document.body.innerText.includes('General consultation') && [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Register & send to cashier')
description: The fee preview shows the charge and the button names the next stop

name: fd-03-registered-and-booked
assert: (() => { const p = window.designAudit.rows.patients.find(x => x.fullName === 'Synthetic Front Desk Patient'); return window.designAudit.path === '/patients/profile' && Boolean(p) && window.designAudit.rows.appointments.some(a => a.patientId === p.id && a.visitType === 'general') && document.body.innerText.includes('to pay at the cashier'); })()
description: One save registers, books for now and says where the patient goes

name: gen5c-all-default
assert: (() => { const show = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(s => s.labels[0]?.textContent === 'Show'); const total = window.designAudit.rows.appointments.length; const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr').length; return show?.value === 'all' && show.options[0].textContent === 'All (' + total + ')' && rows === total && document.body.innerText.includes('Any date') && !document.body.innerText.includes('Show them') && !document.querySelector('#expected-heading'); })()
description: All is the default view: every booking listed, All first with its count, dates available and no overdue reminder

name: fd-04-expected
assert: document.querySelector('#expected-heading')?.textContent.startsWith('Expected')
description: Today is split into expected and arrived

assert: (() => { const heads = [...document.querySelectorAll('table thead th')]; const labels = heads.map(th => th.textContent.replace(/[↕↑↓]/g, '').trim()); return labels.join('|') === 'Patient|When|Visit|Status|Actions' && heads.every(th => getComputedStyle(th.querySelector('button') ?? th).fontSize === '12px') && [...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody td')].every(td => getComputedStyle(td).verticalAlign === 'middle') && !document.querySelector('table tbody button:not([aria-label^="Actions for"])'); })()
description: GEN-5: five columns with uniform 12px headings, vertically centred rows and only a ⋯ menu in each row

assert: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll("button[aria-label='Actions for Amaka Okoro']")].find(n => n.getClientRects().length).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', { bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse' })); return true; })()
description: GEN-5: rest the mouse on the row ⋯ button

name: fd-04b-row-menu-hover
assert: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=menu] [role=menuitem]')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()); return items[0] === 'Record arrival' && items.includes('View booking') && items.includes('View patient details') && !document.activeElement?.closest('[role=menu]'); })()
description: GEN-5: hovering opens the ⋯ menu with the main action first, without taking keyboard focus

assert: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll("button[aria-label='Actions for Amaka Okoro']")].find(n => n.getClientRects().length).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerout', { bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse', relatedTarget: document.body })); return true; })()
description: GEN-5: move the mouse away

assert: !document.querySelector('[role=menu]')
description: GEN-5: the hover menu closes when the mouse leaves

assert: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll("button[aria-label='Actions for Amaka Okoro']")].find(n => n.getClientRects().length).click(); return true; })()
description: GEN-5: click the row ⋯ button

assert: Boolean(document.querySelector('[role=menu]')) && document.activeElement?.getAttribute('role') === 'menuitem'
description: GEN-5: clicking (or tapping) opens the same menu and moves focus into it for keyboard users

name: fd-05-arrived
assert: (() => { const a = window.designAudit.rows.appointments.find(x => x.id === 'appointment:today'); return a.attendance === 'arrived' && JSON.parse(a.activity).map(x => x.action).join(',') === 'arrived' && document.querySelector('#arrived-heading')?.textContent === 'Arrived or in care · 1' && !document.body.innerText.includes('Undo arrival'); })()
description: Record arrival from the ⋯ menu is attributed in the booking history and moves the row to Arrived

name: gen5b-filter-row
assert: (() => { const search = document.querySelector('#appointment-search'), show = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(s => s.labels[0]?.textContent === 'Show'); const row = search.closest('.flex-wrap'); return !document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Appointment groups"]') && !document.body.innerText.includes('Filter appointments') && show?.value === 'today' && /\(\d+\)/.test(show.options[0].textContent) && !document.body.innerText.includes('Any date') && search.getBoundingClientRect().width > row.getBoundingClientRect().width * 0.55 && document.body.innerText.includes('1 overdue booking') && /\d+ bookings? today/.test(document.body.innerText); })()
description: GEN-5: one filter row with a wide search and a Show select instead of tabs; no filter card or attendance select; no dates under Today; overdue bookings still flagged

assert: window.designAudit.search.includes('group=overdue') && document.body.innerText.includes('Any date')
description: GEN-5: Show them switches to overdue bookings, where the date range appears

assert: Boolean(document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label=Dates]'))
description: GEN-5: the date range opens its quick choices and date fields

name: gen5b-last-7-days
assert: (() => { const p = new URLSearchParams(window.designAudit.search); return Boolean(p.get('from') && p.get('to')) && p.get('from') < p.get('to') && [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l => l.textContent === 'Dates').control.textContent.includes('–') && !document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label=Dates]'); })()
description: GEN-5: a quick choice applies at once, labels the range and keeps it in the address

assert: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l => l.textContent === 'Dates').control.click(); return true; })()
description: GEN-5: reopen the date range

assert: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Apply dates')?.disabled === true && document.body.innerText.includes('The end date must be on or after the start date.')
description: GEN-5: an end date before the start cannot be applied

assert: (() => { document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Clear dates"]').click(); return true; })()
description: GEN-5: cancel, then clear the dates

assert: !new URLSearchParams(window.designAudit.search).get('from') && document.body.innerText.includes('Any date')
description: GEN-5: clearing returns to any date

assert: (() => { document.querySelector("table button[aria-label^='Actions for ']").click(); return true; })()
description: GEN-5: open the overdue row ⋯ menu

name: fd-06-rebook
assert: document.querySelector('dialog[open]')?.innerText.includes('Reschedule') && document.querySelector('dialog[open]')?.innerText.includes('Missed follow-up')
description: A missed booking opens the existing reschedule directly

name: fd-07-in-clinic-today
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('In clinic today') && document.body.innerText.includes('Amaka Okoro') && !document.body.innerText.includes('With a balance')
description: In clinic today lists today's patients; balances stay hidden from a role without billing access

name: patients-show-filter
description: Patients: a Show select replaces the tabs, defaults to All patients with counts, and hides balances from a role without billing access
assert: (() => { const show = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(s => s.labels[0]?.textContent === 'Show'); const labels = [...show.options].map(o => o.textContent); const text = document.body.innerText.match(/(\d+) of (\d+) patients/); return !document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Patient care type"]') && show.value === 'all' && /^All patients \(\d+\)$/.test(labels[0]) && ['In clinic today', 'Inpatients', 'Outpatients'].every(v => labels.some(l => l.startsWith(v))) && !labels.some(l => l.startsWith('With a balance')) && Boolean(text) && text[1] === text[2]; })()

description: Patients: choosing a view keeps it in the address
assert: new URLSearchParams(window.designAudit.search).get('care') === 'today' && [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(s => s.labels[0]?.textContent === 'Show').value === 'today'

description: Patients: an unknown view falls back to all patients
assert: (() => { const show = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(s => s.labels[0]?.textContent === 'Show'); const text = document.body.innerText.match(/(\d+) of (\d+) patients/); return show.value === 'all' && Boolean(text) && text[1] === text[2]; })()

name: fd-08-identity-compare
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('recorded details agree') && Boolean(document.querySelector('table th[scope=row]'))
description: Two records are compared side by side

name: gen5-phone-cards
assert: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && Boolean(document.querySelector('ul[aria-label=Appointments] button[aria-label^="Actions for"]'))
description: GEN-5: phones show cards with the same ⋯ menu and no sideways scrolling

name: gen7-patient-list
assert: !document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Patients & Front Desk navigation"]').innerText.includes('Register patient') && [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Register patient' && b.getClientRects().length)
description: GEN-7: the sidebar has no Register patient entry; the patient list has a Register patient button

name: gen7-form-wide
assert: (() => { const form = document.querySelector('form'); const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].map(l => l.textContent.trim()); const active = document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Patients & Front Desk navigation"]').querySelector('[aria-current=page]'); return window.designAudit.path === '/patients/new' && active?.textContent.trim() === 'Patients' && form.getBoundingClientRect().width >= 900 && ['Phone (optional)', 'Occupation (optional)', 'Old folder / card number (optional)', 'NIN (optional)'].every(text => labels.includes(text)) && document.body.innerText.includes('Religion (optional)') && !document.body.innerText.includes('More details') && document.querySelector('input[name=occupation]').getClientRects().length > 0 && document.querySelector('input[name=fullName]').getBoundingClientRect().top === document.querySelector('input[name=phone]').getBoundingClientRect().top; })()
description: GEN-7: the button opens a wide two-column form with Patients still highlighted, and every optional field visible and labelled optional

name: gen7-form-tablet
assert: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && document.querySelector('input[name=fullName]').getBoundingClientRect().top === document.querySelector('input[name=phone]').getBoundingClientRect().top
description: GEN-7: tablets keep two columns without sideways scrolling

name: fd-09-phone
assert: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && document.body.innerText.includes('Visit today')
description: The one-screen registration fits a 320px phone
